narrative_engine.thesis: Price is stretched 2.20σ from the Day VWAP with crowding exhausted; the reversal proof (abs) says fade it back down toward the mean. Stop sits beyond ±3σ at 0.0036986; T1 at 0.0034306 pays 3.10R with the magnet at the 0σ VWAP.

plan.invalidation: ±3σ VWAP (0.0036986) or 0.4 ATR past the sweep
